subject: High error rate + latency during peak — QuickSave reserved capacity impact
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@quicksave.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: QuickSave SRE <sre@quicksave.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Immediate: Spike in 5xx and token latency impacting checkout flow

Neha —

We hit a sustained window of 5xx errors and large tail latency on our checkout LLM calls between 10:45–11:05 UTC this morning. Our metrics show request success rate for the route /v1/generate dropped from ~99.6% to ~86% and mean token latency increased from ~40ms to ~420ms (tail >> 1s). This is impacting customer transactions — we saw a measurable increase in cart abandonment during the window.

Attached is a small sample of logs (quicksave-5xx-sample-29jun.log) and a screenshot of request rate. QuickSave is on a reserved capacity commitment with you (deal QS-2026-PRIO). We need immediate clarity: what caused this, why did our reserved throughput fall below our committed baseline, and what is being done to prevent recurrence?

Please loop in ops/eng and advise ETA for remediation and any short-term mitigations. This is priority for our ops and product teams.

— Alex
CTO, QuickSave

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Immediate: Spike in 5xx and token latency impacting checkout flow

Team — forwarding QuickSave alert. Summary: dedicated pool sd-pool-19 appears to have hit sustained queueing; customer saw a drop below their reserved throughput and spikes of 5xx. QuickSave is on a strategic reserved contract (QS-2026-PRIO) — this needs fast triage and an exec-visible remediation timeline.

Asks:
- Jonas: can you lead immediate triage (pool-level telemetry, per-customer queue-depth, model-level kernel OOMs)?
- Ops: short-term mitigation options (burst capacity, routing to hosted fallback, token caps, temp model downgrade) — what can we enact in the next 30–90 minutes?
- Marissa/Rishi: please own customer comms and credit/comp conversation if we confirm reserve shortfall. I want a proposed customer-facing note in the next 45 minutes.

We should assume this is escalating to QuickSave execs if we cannot restore baseline within 1 hour. Please post updates to the incident bridge (using the Grafana link) and include any immediate action you take.

— Neha
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 08:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Immediate: Spike in 5xx and token latency impacting checkout flow

Quick triage notes (observed 08:20–08:45 PT):

- Pool: sd-pool-19 (dedicated for a set of high-throughput customers including QuickSave) showed persistent CPU/GPU utilization at 97–99% and enqueue depth rising to 480 requests.
- Symptoms: request queueing (long tail latency), occasional model-serving 5xx where session KV cache misses caused retry cascades. No host OOMs, but kernel-level slowdowns on long sequences increased per-request GPU time by ~6–8x.
- Customer effect: per-route throughput for QuickSave dropped ~35% vs their committed baseline during the peak.

Immediate recommended actions (can be executed in parallel):
1) Enable emergency burst capacity for QuickSave on sd-pool-19 (+2 GPUs hot-add). This will be visible in hostpool within ~8–12 minutes but requires approval for a temporary over-commit charge.
2) Route QuickSave traffic for non-critical routes to hosted fallback model redwood-chat-7b-8q (slightly smaller, quantized) — drops p99 latency, compatible with current prompts. This will reduce peak token time while preserving correctness for checkout flows. (Config change estimate: ~10 minutes).
3) Apply a per-route soft-token-cap for QuickSave to smooth bursts (limit concurrent user requests to 220).
4) Investigate model input distribution — we saw a spike in sequence length (prompt inflation) from QuickSave's partner passthrough. SRE requesting a short profile from their SRE team.

I'll start the hot-add and route-change once Neha/Marissa confirm customer comms and billing approval for temporary burst. Creating bridge now: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/POOL/sd-pool-19?from=now-2h&to=now

— Jonas
Head of Serving Core
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@quicksave.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Immediate: Spike in 5xx and token latency impacting checkout flow

Alex —

Thank you for the log sample and heads-up. We understand the impact and are treating this as high priority. Quick status: our serving team has identified sd-pool-19 queueing as the root of the degradation and are initiating the following immediate mitigations:

• Hot-add +2 GPUs to sd-pool-19 (expected stabilization ~10–15 minutes).
• Route non-critical routes to a quantized fallback model to reduce per-token GPU time (~10 minutes).
• Apply a soft concurrency cap to smooth bursts while we stabilize.

We will also open an internal postmortem and follow up with a prevention plan (token-level throttles, prompt-size advisories, and model selection guidance). We expect baseline reserved throughput to be restored within the hour. If any of these mitigations materially change cost or require an overage charge, we'll surface that immediately.

As next steps: please confirm you are comfortable with the temporary routing to the quantized fallback (redwood-chat-7b-8q) for non-checkout prompts and your SRE can share a short profile of the input sizes (or allow us to sample) to help root cause. We will provide a short executive readout once the baseline is stable.

Apologies for the disruption — we'll keep you updated on every step.

— Marissa Cole
Senior Account Manager, Strategic Customers
Redwood Inference

Attachment: qsave-grafana-request-rate.png

From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@quicksave.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Immediate: Spike in 5xx and token latency impacting checkout flow

Thanks — we saw improvement after ~18 minutes (success rate back to ~98.9%, tail latency mostly reduced). Appreciate the quick action.

Couple of asks:
1) Please confirm whether this will count as a breach of our reserved throughput SLA and what compensation you propose (we logged lost transactions during the window).
2) Can you provide the postmortem and the mitigation timeline (including changes to our routing and any permanent config changes)?
3) We'll share an SRE profile of the recent payloads in the next 30 minutes — cc'ing our SRE.

If you can get an exec readout scheduled this afternoon that would help inform our leadership.

— Alex
CTO, QuickSave
